description: This Python source file implements the Azure Speech-to-Text (STT) service for the Pipecat project. It provides classes and methods to initialize, start, stop, and handle real-time audio transcription using Azure Cognitive Services Speech SDK. The key class, AzureSTTService, manages speech recognition, processes audio streams, and handles recognition events, supporting continuous recognition with real-time callbacks.

classes.name: AzureSTTService
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the Azure Cognitive Services Speech SDK to provide real-time speech recognition capabilities within the Pipecat framework, handling start, stop, cancel, and event callbacks for transcription.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, region: str, language: Language = Language.EN_US, sample_rate: Optional[int] = None, endpoint_id: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AzureSTTService with configuration parameters such as API key, region, language, sample rate, and optional endpoint ID, setting up the speech config and internal state.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Returns True, indicating this service supports metrics collection for performance monitoring.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Processes incoming audio bytes by feeding them into the audio stream and yields None or ErrorFrame depending on success or failure.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Initializes the speech recognizer with a new audio stream and starts continuous recognition, handling exceptions during setup.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the ongoing recognition and closes audio streams gracefully.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Immediately stops recognition and releases resources upon cancellation.

methods.name: _handle_transcription( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[Language] = None )
methods.description: Handles transcription results, performing metrics stopping and tracing; invoked asynchronously upon recognition events.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognized(self, event)
methods.description: Event callback fired when speech is recognized, creates transcription frames, and schedules async handling.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognizing(self, event)
methods.description: Event callback for interim recognition results, creating interim transcription frames.
